method_notes: Predictions prioritize defensive solidity shown in the group and Round of 32 stages, while accounting for host advantages and extra-time fatigue from previous penalty shootouts.

predictions.reasoning: France's high-caliber squad will comfortably progress against a fatigued Paraguay side that endured a grueling penalty shootout.
Morocco carries strong momentum after knocking out the Netherlands and will edge a closely contested battle with Canada.
Brazil's formidable tournament pedigree and balanced squad depth should prove too stable for Norway's defensive setup.
Co-hosts Mexico will leverage overwhelming home support to survive a close encounter with England and progress past regular time.
Spain's immaculate defensive record remains unbroken as they narrowly shut down Portugal's frontline.
The United States relies on strong defensive structure and home advantage to punish a Belgium side prone to conceding goals.
Argentina's potent attacking core will easily break down an Egypt side that is heavily fatigued from an extra-time battle.
